title: Sending the drone in first
target: How to use a R.E.P.O. drone deliberately, given that the game lets it target valuables, players, enemies and ordinary objects rather than only one of them.
version: R.E.P.O. v0.4.0, as installed for this build (see the sources page for the exact version string)
prerequisites: A drone in the crew's hands
A room you would rather not walk into

steps.do: Decide what the drone is for before it goes out.
steps.because: the drone has separate targeting for valuables, players, enemies and ordinary objects (targetValuables)

steps.do: Check it is not set to go for players before you deploy it.
steps.because: players sit on the same targeting list as the loot (targetPlayers)

steps.do: Watch the line it draws rather than assuming it is on the right thing.
steps.because: the drone keeps a line between two points to show its target (lineBetweenTwoPoints)

steps.do: Do not count on it lasting the whole level.
steps.because: the drone runs on a battery with its own drain setting (batteryDrainPreset)

steps.do: Send it in before the crew rather than after somebody is already in trouble.
steps.because: deploying and retracting are deliberate steps with their own sounds (DroneDeploy)

commonMistakes: Deploying a drone that is set to target players.
Letting it run out of battery in the middle of a room.
Treating the drone as a substitute for looking where you are going.
sources: This installation of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
